# My Aadhaar UIDAI Login – Easy Download & Check Status 2026

The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) oversees the Aadhaar project, which provides a
12-digit unique identity number to Indian residents. Established by the Government of India in 2009,
UIDAI manages key Aadhaar services through the My Aadhaar portal, offering a streamlined approach
for citizens to download e-Aadhaar, update personal details, and track their status. The platform
also supports features like generating a Virtual ID (VID), ordering PVC Aadhaar cards, and checking
Aadhaar status—all designed to simplify processes for users.

**[Aadhaar UIDAI][19]** services help users easily access essential Aadhaar-related information and
guidance online. As one of the world’s largest biometric identity systems, Aadhaar connects
residents to various government services, banking, and mobile communications, ensuring nationwide
accessibility. Through its continuous updates and mobile-friendly services, UIDAI ensures a secure
and accessible experience for all users, reinforcing India’s push towards digital governance. With
key features like biometric authentication and digital verification, the platform enhances
transparency and safeguards against identity fraud, making it an integral part of daily life for
millions of Indians.

# My Aadhaar UIDAI Login – Easy Download & Check Status 2026

The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) oversees the Aadhaar project, which provides a
12-digit unique identity number to Indian residents. Established by the Government of India in 2009,
UIDAI manages key Aadhaar services through the My Aadhaar portal, offering a streamlined approach
for citizens to download e-Aadhaar, update personal details, and track their status. The platform
also supports features like generating a Virtual ID (VID), ordering PVC Aadhaar cards, and checking
Aadhaar status—all designed to simplify processes for users.

**[Aadhaar UIDAI][19]** services help users easily access essential Aadhaar-related information and
guidance online. As one of the world’s largest biometric identity systems, Aadhaar connects
residents to various government services, banking, and mobile communications, ensuring nationwide
accessibility. Through its continuous updates and mobile-friendly services, UIDAI ensures a secure
and accessible experience for all users, reinforcing India’s push towards digital governance. With
key features like biometric authentication and digital verification, the platform enhances
transparency and safeguards against identity fraud, making it an integral part of daily life for
millions of Indians.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

Fokus kami adalah kemitraan jangka panjang: dari konsultasi, implementasi, hingga layanan terkelola.

System Integration
Network & Infrastructure
Security Assessment
Managed Security

## Our Services

Layanan System Integrator & Cybersecurity yang siap disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan organisasi Anda.

## Our Partners

Kami berkolaborasi dengan partner teknologi untuk menghadirkan solusi System Integrator &

#### Connectme Maroc offre des solutions complètes en cybersécurité, cloud et data backup pour
#### assurer la protection et la performance de votre entreprise.

[[fortinet maroc]][30]

Offrant des solutions de sécurité réseau, de gestion des menaces et de protection des données pour
les entreprises de toutes tailles.

Les produits Microsoft au Maroc offrent des solutions technologiques avancées, permettant aux
entreprises et utilisateurs de booster leur productivité et d'optimiser leur gestion numérique.

### [Sophos Maroc][37]

Sophos est un leader mondial de la cybersécurité, offrant des solutions de pointe pour protéger les
entreprises contre les cybermenaces de plus en plus complexes. Avec des produits innovants tels que
des antivirus intelligents et des protections contre les ransomwares

technologie de pointe, vous bénéficiez d'une protection sans faille contre les menaces en ligne,
tout en assurant une performance optimale de vos appareils.

Acronis protège vos données avec des solutions de sauvegarde innovantes, assurant sécurité et
récupération rapide. Protégez vos fichiers contre les menaces et récupérez-les en un instant, où que
vous soyez.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

# Sanchar Saathi Portal – TAFCOP, Download App & Check SIM Card Details 2026

The **[Sanchar Saathi Portal][18]** is a citizen-friendly initiative by the Department of
Telecommunications (DoT), Government of India, aimed at protecting mobile users from fraud, misuse,
and mobile theft. Through this platform, users can check how many SIM cards are linked to their
Aadhaar, verify the authenticity of their mobile devices, and even block lost or stolen phones. The
integrated system also ensures that telecom services remain transparent and accountable.

In an era of rising digital threats, identity theft, and SIM-related scams, Sanchar Saathi empowers
users to monitor and manage their telecom connections securely.

## **What Is Sanchar Saathi Portal?**

Sanchar Saathi is both a web portal and a mobile app that provides multiple services related to
mobile security and SIM verification. It combines several key modules developed by the DoT to
strengthen consumer safety:
* **CEIR (Central Equipment Identity Register) –** a database that tracks and blocks lost or stolen
  mobile phones.
* **TAFCOP (Telecom Analytics for Fraud Management and Consumer Protection)** – a platform that
  helps users check the number of active SIMs issued in their name.
* **KYM (Know Your Mobile) – **a service that allows users to verify if a mobile device is genuine
  or blacklisted.

The Sanchar Saathi Portal ([www.sancharsaathi.gov.in][27]) allows users to access these features
under a single interface, making it easy to check SIM cards, block stolen phones, and safeguard
personal data.

## **Why Sanchar Saathi Portal is in News**

Recently, the Sanchar Saathi App came into the spotlight when the Department of Telecommunications
issued new directions on 28 November 2025. According to the latest rules, all mobile phone
manufacturers and importers must pre-install the Sanchar Saathi app on every new device sold in
India.

This step aims to make security features accessible to every smartphone user and ensure that
individuals can quickly report lost devices, verify IMEI numbers, and prevent SIM misuse without
needing separate apps or websites.

## **Objectives of Sanchar Saathi Portal**

The main objectives of the Sanchar Saathi Portal are:
* To protect citizens from fake, duplicate, or tampered mobile devices
* To prevent SIM frauds and identity misuse
* To help users report lost or stolen phones easily
* To support cyber safety and block suspicious activity
* To improve transparency in the telecom sector by letting users monitor their own connections

By integrating TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi and CEIR services, the portal strengthens both consumer
awareness and network-level protection.

## **Understanding TAFCOP – Sanchar Saathi Know Your Mobile Connection**

TAFCOP Sanchar Saathi is an essential component of the Sanchar Saathi system. It enables users to
find out how many SIM cards are linked to their identity using their Aadhaar or mobile number.

Here’s how you can use the TAFCOP portal for Aadhaar card mobile number check:
1. Visit the official [**TAFCOP Portal**][28]
2. Enter your mobile number and click on Generate OTP
3. Verify the OTP received on your registered phone
4. The system will display all active SIM cards associated with your Aadhaar number
5. If you find an unknown connection, you can report or block it directly from the portal

This process, also known as Sanchar Saathi SIM Check, ensures that your telecom identity is not
misused for unauthorized activities.

## **Central Equipment Identity Register (CEIR) – Role and Functions**

The CEIR system plays a crucial role in maintaining the national IMEI database. Every mobile phone
has a unique IMEI (International Mobile Equipment Identity) number. The CEIR helps ensure that only
genuine devices operate on Indian telecom networks.

**Functions of CEIR include:**
* Blocking lost or stolen phones across all Indian networks
* Preventing the use of fake or cloned IMEI numbers
* Assisting police and security agencies in tracing stolen devices
* Allowing users to unblock recovered devices

Through CEIR, users can visit the Sanchar Saathi Portal, enter their IMEI number, and block a stolen
phone instantly. This helps reduce mobile theft and the illegal sale of blacklisted devices.

# What is Secure Access?

Secure Access is an access control service with authentication. It provides an additional layer of
security to Internet facing web applications.

Secure Access performs as an intermediary between the requests of users and the servers of the
corporate web applications.

When a user accesses an internal web application, the first thing that appears is the Secure Access
login page.

Therefore, the cloud service protects the connection between the user and the company's web
applications exposed to the Internet.

Once authenticated with the username, password and through the double factor authentication, Secure
Access forwards the user's request to the final web server.

[ Download our White Paper ][9]

## Getting started with Secure Access

[Activate your free trial for 1 month]

### 1. Get a free trial.

Sign up and choose the 30 days free subscription.

[Create a domain and subdomain at Secure Access]

### 2. Add your domains.

Set up the general settings of your company and add the domains and subdomains in your Secure Access
control panel.

[Change your DNS]

### 3. Change your DNS.

Point your DNS, domains and subdomains to my.secureaccess.com.

[Generate your certificates]

### 4. Generate your HTTPS certificates.

Free of charge, you can generate your certificates or upload them to the platform.

[Configure a user directory at Secure Access]

### 5. Create the user directory.

Add or import users by synchronizing LDAP or Active Directory and manage user groups and access
permissions.

[Configure the Secure Access 2FA]

### 6. Configure the 2FA.

Activate the double factor authentication (2FA) and block any traffic from another IP other than
Secure Access.

[Secure Access Integrative Web Applications]

### Integrative web applications

Secure Access can integrate every type of web application: from project management tools,

type of network.

[Secure Access Applicable Authentication Providers]

### Authentication providers

To reinforce your protection, you'll be able to integrate Secure Access with authentication

[Secure Access Personalisation]

### Personalisation

Secure Access has an intuitive and minimalist control panel that can manage the authorisation of
both individual and groups of users. The unified authentication proxy can also provide access,
configuration, activation, and deactivation.

### **Powering the Market Leading SASE, XDR, ZTNA, Web Filtering, and Brand Safety Solutions**

## Power Your Security & Safety Applications with Industry-Leading Intelligence

zvelo uses proprietary AI-based web classification, threat detection, and curation technologies to
analyze traffic from over 1 billion users and endpoints. This data is enriched with intelligence
from OSINT and third-party feeds to deliver unparalleled visibility, coverage, and accuracy. The
result is comprehensive URL classifications and intelligence data spanning domains, full-path URLs,
SaaS applications, phishing threats, and other malicious activities — powering a wide range of
applications and solutions.

[Domain Intelligence & Web Classification]

#### **Domain Intelligence & Web Classification**

Optimize your solutions with the industry’s most accurate and comprehensive URL classification
database, delivering precise, real-time categorizations to protect users and enhance digital
experiences. Achieve unmatched performance for web filtering, parental controls, brand safety,
contextual targeting, and more.

[Explore zveloDB URL Database][53]

Transform your approach to data security with advanced intelligence on SaaS Applications. Gain

data leakage and exfiltration and fully control access to SaaS Applications.

[Explore SaaS App Intelligence][54]
[Phishing Detection for Blocking and Threat Research]

positives.
